messages.content: Implement a Python function from a JSON behavioral card. The card is the only task specification. Return a JSON object with a single string field code containing executable Python source. Define solve with the card's exact signature. Use only Python's standard library. Allowed imports: math, itertools, functools, collections, heapq, bisect, statistics, fractions, operator, typing. Do not import or call NumPy, SymPy, NetworkX or any other third-party library. Do not read files, use network, introspection, eval, exec, input or print. Implement computations yourself using built-ins and the allowed standard library. Return plain JSON-compatible values, not iterators or sets; use string keys in dictionaries. Include any helper functions in the code. No tests or main block. Raise ValueError where the card requires it.

Implement this card:
{
  "algorithm": [
    "Use Dijkstra's algorithm for unweighted graphs",
    "Initialize distances to infinity",
    "Set distance to source as 0",
    "Relax edges in order of increasing distance",
    "Stop when all reachable nodes are processed"
  ],
  "constraints": [
    "Vertices are 0 to n-1",
    "Edges are distinct and 0 <= u < v < n",
    "Source is a valid vertex",
    "No cutoff specified, so all reachable nodes are included"
  ],
  "edge_cases": [
    "Source is the only node in the graph",
    "No edges exist, so all nodes are isolated",
    "Graph is disconnected, some nodes are unreachable"
  ],
  "inputs": "n: integer >= 1, edges: list of distinct [u, v] pairs with 0 <= u < v < n, source: valid vertex",
  "method_id": "networkx.single_source_shortest_path_length",
  "output": "Dict with string vertex keys and integer shortest-path lengths for reachable nodes, including source:0",
  "purpose": "Compute the shortest path lengths from `source` to all reachable nodes in the graph `G`.",
  "signature": "solve(n, edges, source)"
}
